title: Ledger entry
description: One file at docs/ledger/<kind>/<key[:2]>/<key>.json (decision 0079). It holds no timestamp, so equal results are byte-identical; provenance lives in a separate .prov.json file. Only pass and fail are stored: an error or an unavailable check is never a ledger result. Key = sha256 of the canonical JSON of key_version, kind, version, tier, tools and inputs, so verify can recompute it from the entry alone.

key_version.description: Version of the key scheme hashed into the key; a new scheme is a miss, never a stale hit.

version.description: Procedure or check version hashed into the key.

tier.description: Tier hashed into the key (for example 1, 2 or script).

tools.description: Declared tool versions hashed into the key; may be empty.

inputs.description: Declared input name to content hash, so verify can recompute the key and explain can name the input that differs.

result.description: Kind-specific payload: a verdict, or the capped and redacted failing lines of a check. Never source or manuscript text.
